description.en: A renewable one-year personal accident-insurance scheme for eligible individual bank or post-office account holders, covering accidental death and specified permanent disability.

benefit_summary.en: The scheme pays Rs 2 lakh for accidental death or specified total permanent disability and Rs 1 lakh for specified partial permanent disability. The current annual premium shown by the official source is Rs 20 per member, paid by auto-debit.

eligibility_summary.en: An individual account holder aged 18 through 70 may join through one participating bank or post-office account. Exact claim coverage depends on the accident and disability definitions in the policy.

prompt.en: What is your age in completed years?
Do you have an individual account at a participating bank or post office?

description.en: The applicant is at least 18 years old.
The applicant is no more than 70 years old.
The applicant has an eligible individual bank or post-office account.

name.en: Participating bank or post-office account details

instruction.en: Ask the participating bank or post office for the current PMSBY terms and enrolment form.
Submit the consent and auto-debit authorisation through only one eligible account.
Keep nominee details current and retain the policy and claim instructions.

citation.publisher: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
